Innodome & Innowheel

Sheet-to-tube enrichment; 100% paper pulp enrichment sheets are uniquely designed to transform into a tube shape to encourage rodents' natural climbing and nesting instincts.

Key Advantages:

  • Keeps rodents active and helps reduce aggression.
  • Can be combined with Innorichment sheets to offer more enrichment and complex, higher-scoring nests.
  • Each sheet can be rolled into a locked tube shape to provide shelter and nesting material.
  • For mouse caging.
